actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Microsoft Word action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your Word connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: accept_tracked_change
actions.title: Accept tracked change
actions.description: Accept tracked change in Microsoft Word
actions.help: Accepts a specific tracked change by its ID. For insertions, the text becomes permanent. For deletions, the deleted text is removed.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: add_comment
actions.title: Add comment
actions.help: Adds a comment to the document anchored to a specific paragraph. The comment is created under the authenticated user's identity.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: create_document
actions.title: Create document
actions.help: Creates a new Word document or copies an existing template. Supports blank documents, XML content, binary upload, or template-based creation.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File destination
input.hint: Select where the document will be saved.

actions.name: download_document
actions.title: Download document
actions.help: Downloads the document in XML, binary (.docx), or PDF format.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: get_document_content
actions.title: Get document content
actions.description: Get document content in Microsoft Word
actions.help: Returns structured content blocks (headings, paragraphs, lists, tables) from a Word document. Supports filtering by section heading, block type, and text search. Use Max blocks and Page token to paginate through large documents.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: get_document_info
actions.title: Get document info
actions.description: Get document info in Microsoft Word
actions.help: Retrieves metadata and properties of a Word document, including file size, dates, and parent folder information.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: list_comments
actions.title: List comments
actions.help: Lists comment threads including replies and resolved status. Supports filtering by resolution state and pagination.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: list_tracked_changes
actions.title: List tracked changes
actions.description: List tracked changes in Microsoft Word
actions.help: Lists pending tracked changes (insertions, deletions, formatting changes) with author and location information. Supports filtering by author and pagination.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: reject_tracked_change
actions.title: Reject tracked change
actions.description: Reject tracked change in Microsoft Word
actions.help: Rejects a specific tracked change by its ID. For insertions, the inserted text is removed. For deletions, the deleted text is restored.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: reopen_comment
actions.title: Reopen comment
actions.help: Reopens a previously resolved comment thread.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: reply_to_comment
actions.title: Reply to comment
actions.description: Reply to comment in Microsoft Word
actions.help: Adds a reply to an existing comment thread under the authenticated user's identity. Fails if the thread is already resolved.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: resolve_comment
actions.title: Resolve comment
actions.help: Marks a comment thread as resolved. Idempotent — resolving an already-resolved comment succeeds without error.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.

actions.name: update_document
actions.title: Update document
actions.description: Update document content in Microsoft Word
actions.help: Applies block-level operations (insert, replace, delete by element ID) or replaces the full document content.

input.name: file_source
input.label: File source
input.hint: Select where the document is stored.
